title: Change the details on your bus driver authority online
summary: You can apply online to Transport for NSW for a replacement bus driver authority if you have changed your name.
intro: If you have changed your name, you can apply to Transport for NSW for a replacement bus driver authority online.
what_you_need: a replacement driver licence with your new details
a copy of a proof of identity document (if you hold an interstate driver licence)
an original change of name document
a digital photo (if you don't hold a valid NSW driver licence and have not submitted a previous application online)

more_info.text: Your application cannot be saved to continue at a later date.
If your application is submitted successfully, you'll receive an email and PDF copy of your application.
The holder of a driver licence must advise Transport for NSW within 7 days if any of their details change.
